document: Insurance claim or notification form (possibly blank), Hungarian
glossary: Document type: Insurance claim or notification form (possibly blank), Hungarian. Field names are English identifiers; the document text is verbatim, usually Hungarian.

field_specs.form_title: the form title as printed on the document (A nyomtatvany cime (pl. Gepjarmu-karbejelentesi adatlap, Igenybejelento nyomtatvany, Meghatalmazas))
field_specs.insurer: the insurer as printed on the document (Biztosito / penztar neve, ha szerepel (pl. Allianz, Alfa Onkentes Nyugdijpenztar))
field_specs.form_code: the form code as printed on the document (Nyomtatvany-kod, ha szerepel (pl. AHE-52646, NYP-0076v11))
field_specs.claim_type: the claim type as printed on the document (Kar/igeny tipusa, ha azonosithato (pl. gepjarmu-kar, szemelyserules, aszaly/jegveres, atlepes, azonositas, meghatalmazas))
field_specs.policy_number: the policy number as printed on the document (Szerzodes-/kotvenyszam, ha KITOLTOTT erteke van; ures rubrika eseten null)
field_specs.claimant_name: the claimant name as printed on the document (Bejelento/igenylo neve, ha KITOLTOTT; ures nyomtatvanyon null)
field_specs.is_blank_form: the is blank form as printed on the document (true, ha a nyomtatvany NINCS kitoltve (ures, kitoltheto forma); false, ha kitoltott adatokat tartalmaz)
